typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Sale_Type_CD as string,
		Fyear_ID as string,
		FDay_ID as string,
		BusinessDay_Dt as string,
		BusinessUnit_CD as string,
		Loc_ID as string,
		Comp_ID as string,
		DEPT_ID as string,
		ItemSku_Num as string,
		Customer_Account_ID as string,
		Currency as string,
		Sales as string,
		Cost as string,
		Program_USD_AMT as string,
		Comments as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CPDIMUAdjustments
CPDIMUAdjustments derive(Source = 'CPD_IMU_Adjustments') ~> Addcolumns
Addcolumns derive(Comments = toString(Comments),
		Source = toString(Source)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Loc_ID as integer,
		Sale_Type_CD as integer,
		ItemSku_Num as integer,
		Comments as string,
		FDay_ID as integer,
		Cost as integer,
		Source as string,
		Program_USD_AMT as integer,
		Sales as integer,
		BusinessUnit_CD as string,
		BusinessDay_Dt as integer,
		Customer_Account_ID as integer,
		Currency as string,
		Fyear_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Loc_ID,
		Sale_Type_CD,
		ItemSku_Num,
		Comments,
		FDay_ID,
		Cost,
		Source,
		Program_USD_AMT,
		Sales,
		BusinessUnit_CD,
		BusinessDay_Dt,
		Customer_Account_ID,
		Currency,
		Fyear_ID)) ~> FinanceOtherAdjSalesType
